DEPARTMENT OF INFORMATION SCIENCE
FAKE STANFORD AFFILIATE COLLEGE OF TECHNOLOGY
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Aditya Verma, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2021-2023) at Fake Stanford Affiliate College of Technology.

During this tenure, Aditya Verma demonstrated exceptional mastery in C++, CUDA, Embedded Robotics, ROS2. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'High-Throughput Microservice Architecture for Cloud Streaming', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Aditya Verma displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Aditya Verma among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. Meenakshi Sundaram
Associate Professor
Information Science
Fake Stanford Affiliate College of Technology
Email: .meenakshi.sundaram@fakestanfo.edu
